name: actual_marked_simple_galls_to_detour
header:
theorem actual_marked_simple_galls_to_detour
    (hg : MarkedSimpleGalls N ports) : N.graph.GalledDetour

name: guarded_cycle_detour
header:
theorem guarded_cycle_detour {h a b : V} {e f : E} {W : List E} {keep : E → Prop}
    (hc : (originalGraph G).IsCycleThrough e h a W)
    (hf : (originalGraph G).IsLink f h b) (hfm : f∈W)
    (hkeep : ∀ d ∈ e::W, d≠e → d≠f → keep d) :
    G.UReach (fun d => keep d ∧ G.source d≠h ∧ G.target d≠h) a b

name: incoming_ids_distinct
header:
theorem incoming_ids_distinct {h : V} {e f : E} (hef : e≠f)
    (he : N.graph.target e=h) (hf : N.graph.target f=h) :
    incomingID N e ≠ incomingID N f

name: incoming_parent_transport
header:
theorem incoming_parent_transport {h : V} (hh : N.graph.IsHybrid h) {e : E}
    (he : N.graph.target e=h) :
    ∃ a : SuppressedVertex N,
      (originalGraph (suppressedGraph N ports)).IsLink (incomingID N e)
        ⟨h,actual_hybrid_nonroot N h hh⟩ a ∧
      MarkedIncoming N ports (incomingID N e) ⟨h,actual_hybrid_nonroot N h hh⟩ ∧
      N.graph.UReach (OrdinaryAvoid N h) (N.graph.source e) a.val

name: ordinary_suppressed_edge_expansion
header:
theorem ordinary_suppressed_edge_expansion {h : V} (hroot : h≠N.root)
    (e : SuppressedEdge N) (he : SuppressedOrdinaryAvoid N ports h e) :
    N.graph.UReach (OrdinaryAvoid N h)
      ((suppressedGraph N ports).source e).val ((suppressedGraph N ports).target e).val

name: ordinary_suppressed_walk_expansion
header:
theorem ordinary_suppressed_walk_expansion {h : V} (hroot : h≠N.root)
    {a b : SuppressedVertex N}
    (hw : (suppressedGraph N ports).UReach (SuppressedOrdinaryAvoid N ports h) a b) :
    N.graph.UReach (OrdinaryAvoid N h) a.val b.val
